Ask us directly . How much does an AI project cost? It depends on the complexity of the problem, the data available, the deployment environment and how much customisation is needed. We work in stages, so you never commit to a large budget up front: the discovery stage ends with a high-level estimate, and each later stage is scoped before it starts. How quickly will we see results? The first milestone is a proof of concept on your own data, which shows early whether the approach works. How long it takes depends on data availability and scope; we give you a realistic timeline at the end of the discovery stage. One client on Clutch reports that we completed their proof of concept within four weeks. Do we need a lot of data to start? Not necessarily. Part of the early stage is assessing the data you already have and whether it is enough. If it is not, we tell you plainly and propose options such as data collection, labelling or a different approach. We have delivered projects where public training data was scarce, such as the workplace hygiene detection system. Can you integrate AI into our existing systems? Yes. Integration is a dedicated stage in every project: we connect the model to your data sources and software, fine-tune it on production data and adjust it until it works reliably inside your processes. How do you handle confidential data? We are a German company and work under the GDPR. When data must not leave your organisation, we build solutions that run without third-party AI services, as in the private LLM chatbot we developed for a consulting firm. Our clients on Clutch specifically mention our ethical approach to data and transparent methods. Do you work with companies outside Germany? Yes. Besides our clients in Germany, we have delivered projects for companies in the United States, the United Kingdom, Poland, Serbia and Saudi Arabia, working remotely from our offices in Frankfurt Rhine-Main and Berlin.
